raw_inventory_expectation.authentication: Prompt-15 adapter verifies exact relative paths, bytes, and SHA-256 before data use; extra in-scope files, missing files, changed files, and depth-2 input fail closed
raw_inventory_expectation.depth_2_policy: excluded files are matched only by the frozen inventory boundary and never opened

adapter.release_and_checkpoint_rule: process one family at a time, atomically checkpoint it, release family objects, collect garbage, and pass the monitored RAM recovery boundary before continuing
adapter.matrix_order: stable case/date order defined by the lock

resource_controls.ram_limit_policy: hard-abort the owned process tree when system-available memory reaches 8 GiB or process-tree RSS reaches 24 GiB; preserve the first stop cause and partial evidence
resource_controls.ownership: one supervised spawned worker and its complete process tree

resource_forecast.basis: outcome-blind structural dimensions, raw bytes, dense-float worst cases, Parquet/checkpoint overhead, and conservative packaging allowance; to be replaced by measured pilot forecast
resource_forecast.launch_rule: free results-volume bytes must be at least max(80 GiB, ceil(2.5 * forecast_remaining_output_bytes)); temp volume must retain 20 GiB

pilot_registry.natural_support_rule: unpadded; zero support or permitted selector failure remains visible and unavailable
pilot_registry.sampling_rule: exact frozen selector/model sampling settings and seeds from the canonical lock

atomicity_and_resume.write_rule: all checkpoint files are written through atomic temp-to-final replacement; manifest authenticates content; _SUCCESS is last
atomicity_and_resume.selection_rule: immutable completed authenticated selection fit; archive incomplete pilot/DEV attempt before exact retry
atomicity_and_resume.evaluation_rule: immutable completed authenticated evaluation; archive incomplete pilot/DEV attempt before exact retry
atomicity_and_resume.oot_rule: fail closed on an incomplete OOT evaluation directory because target-linked output may have become inspectable; no second attempt unless evidence proves no inspectable metric and identity is unchanged
atomicity_and_resume.phase_rule: reuse only when phase _SUCCESS authenticates the exact phase manifest and protocol/matrix identities
atomicity_and_resume.lock_rule: exclusive execution lock lives beside, never inside, each atomic output root and is released in finally
atomicity_and_resume.failure_visibility: failed and infeasible registered cells are sealed and remain in 27/30 accounting

measurement_requirements: inventory and each raw scan duration and bytes
base and per-family peak process-tree RSS and system-available RAM
aggregation, checkpoint write/read, join, validation, and publication durations
repeated bounded scan and checkpoint reuse cost
matrix rows, columns, predictors, lineage, split/fold counts, bytes, and identity hashes
per-selector and per-model time, predictions, metrics, support, failure, and resource evidence
pilot-derived DEV/OOT runtime and disk forecast with 20 percent allowance

gate_criteria.success: authenticated 19-record included inventory, no depth-2 open, exact 1,526,659 rows and 1,959 predictors, exact split/fold identities, 27 fit records and 30 accounted evaluations, aligned predictions, no leakage/padding/fallback/overwrite, reconciled logs, and feasible 20-percent-allowance forecast
gate_criteria.abort: supervisor latches first resource, wall-clock, disk, manual-interrupt, worker-crash, or unsafe-pause cause; stops the owned tree; preserves partial evidence; a selector/model stopped by its own locked RSS or wall-time cap is sealed as visible resource-infeasible before an exact pilot/DEV resume
gate_criteria.infeasible: registered method cannot complete inside its locked stage resource/wall-clock limit; preserve authenticated failure and apply only the lock's declared visible-unavailable handling
gate_criteria.blocker: identity, ancestry, protocol, inventory, dimensions, split/fold, target orientation, leakage, atomicity, accounting, scientific scope, or forecast feasibility fails without a predeclared protocol resolution
